Recorded @ Daft House in Paris

Featuring samples from [a=Chaka Khan] recording “[url=http://www.discogs.com/release/297531]Fate[/url]” (Musker / King) EMI Publishing.
Produced under license from Warner Bros Records Inc.
By arrangement with Warner Special Products. Used by permission. 

℗ & © 1998 Roulé Music
Distribution: 33 (0) 1 46 06 16 65 (fax)
Made in France
_______________

Repress of [r=6559465] with slightly different text on label, which is the one used in the next remixes or reissues.
Also there are reissues with different runout, fax number and "Made in the E.U."

Track duration is timed and does not appear on this release. Includes an insert with the label's other releases.

Runout on side A is stamped except  'THE EXCHANGE - NiLZ.' that is etched.
Side B has a text etched.
